About the Project

Cambridge's sensor technologies CDT supports research in sensing and its applications in an uncertain world. Applicants follow the programme's admission guidance and the Cambridge course funding process, with selection for funded places managed through the doctoral training route. University of Cambridge invites applications for a PhD position in this area: Sensor Technologies and Applications CDT PhD, Cambridge 2027. Disciplinary scope: Engineering. Location: Cambridge, United Kingdom. Full funding is provided; financial support is listed as £21,805/year (UKRI minimum stipend 2026/27). Applications close 6 January 2027 (funding deadline).

Research Areas

  • Sensor technologies
  • Engineering
  • Data and measurement

Funding and Duration

ComponentDetails
Award or positionPhD scholarship / studentship
Stipend / salaryUKRI-rate stipend; exact amount not stated

Eligibility and Requirements

English-language requirements and the expected academic standard for the Sensor CDT are published on the Course Directory site. Applicants with degrees from outside the UK should check the published international qualification equivalences.

Application dates

ComponentDetails
Recruitment statusOpen
Deadline / consideration round6 January 2027 (funding deadline)
LocationUnited Kingdom

About University of Cambridge

Cambridge offers research degrees through its departments and colleges. Doctoral training programmes in sensors, environmental science and cardiovascular research have their own selection and funding arrangements alongside university admission.

Official details: Read the programme or project information

Application route: Follow the official application instructions

2026/27 UKRI reference rate: the minimum UKRI doctoral stipend is £21,805 per year, tax-free (London institutions +£2,000), effective 1 October 2026.

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Official Link

Full announcement and application portal: https://cdt.sensors.cam.ac.uk/admissions/applying-from-outside-UK

Source: cdt.sensors.cam.ac.uk - the details in this listing were recorded from this official page.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 6 January 2027 (funding deadline) - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.

How to Apply

Submit your application through the official portal before the deadline: 6 January 2027 (funding deadline). Read the eligibility requirements carefully and prepare all requested documents — early applications are strongly recommended for competitive awards.

Open the official application page ↗
